question: Has Walmart Avocado oils been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Walmart Avocado oils now?
markdown:
A 2026 study published in \[_Applied Food Research_\] by University of California, Davis researchers revealed that 89% of tested processed foods (chips, mayonnaise, and dressings) labeled as containing avocado oil were adulterated with cheaper substitute oils like soybean, canola, or safflower oil, rather than being single-source pure avocado oil. [](https://www.ucdavis.edu/food/news/avocado-oil-chip-youre-eating-may-not-be-made-pure-avocado-oil)

Tested product lots from the following popular brands showed chemical profiles inconsistent with pure or exclusive avocado oil use:

-   **Boulder Canyon** (avocado oil kettle chips)

-   **Siete** (kettle-cooked potato chips and tortilla chips)

-   **Kettle Brand** (avocado oil varieties)

-   **Jackson's** (chips)

-   **Chosen Foods** (mayonnaise and dressing lines)

-   **Primal Kitchen** (mayonnaise and dressing lines)

-   **Sir Kensington's** (avocado oil mayonnaise)

-   **BetterBody Foods** (mayonnaise)

-   **Sensible Portions** (Garden Veggie Straws)

-   **Good Health** (chips)

-   **Brianna's** (balsamic dressing)

-   **Sprouts** (store-brand items) [](https://www.yahoo.com/news/science/articles/consumers-being-duped-avocado-oil-140029712.html)

### Standalone Bottled Oil Concerns

Earlier investigations by independent labs and consumer watchdogs (such as _ConsumerLab_ and _Mamavation_) also flagged various private-label and major commercial refined avocado oils for failing purity standards or carrying elevated levels of plasticizers/phthalates: [](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=26UUT3qBN-o)

-   **Kroger Private Selection**

-   **Kroger Simple Truth Organic**

-   **Trader Joe's** (All Purpose High Heat Cooking Oil) [](https://mamavation.com/food/avocado-oils-tested-for-phthalates-buying-guide.html)
